record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare MUD_SHOT: Wooper (1 star) and Quagsire (2 stars). The strategy is shared; values are indexed by the casting unit's stars. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Single-target: deals special damage to the caster's current target and then subtracts from its speed stat. Requested damage 25 / 50 / 100 / 200 by caster stars (25 Wooper, 50 Quagsire), raw; applied = x(1 + AP/100), x critPower on a crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT), then reduced by the target's special defense with a minimum of 1. Requested speed change -10 / -20 / -30 / -40 by caster stars (-10 Wooper, -20 Quagsire): despite the source comment ("attack speed ... %"), the code passes a flat number to addSpeed(-speedDebuff, caster, 1, crit), i.e. flat speed points, multiplied by (1 + AP/100) and by critPower on a crit, changed by a Twist Band on the target (debuff becomes a buff) and by the MELMETAL passive (becomes half as an attack change), and clamped to 0..300. The speed change is not conditional on the damage: it is applied even if the damage was blocked by protect/skydiving/magicBounce.

targeting.note: requiresTarget is the default true; the target argument is the unit the caster is attacking.

declaredRaw.label: raw special damage by caster stars (requested amount)

effects.scaling: requested = 25 (Wooper, 1 star) / 50 (Quagsire, 2 stars). Applied: x(1 + caster AP / 100) (apBoost default true), x2 if the caster is enraged, crit factor 1 + (critPower - 1) x reduction only if crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: no damage if the target has protect, skydiving or magicBounce (magicBounce can reflect part to the caster). Then PokemonState.handleDamage: special damage / (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), armorReduction halves speDef, minimum 1 after Math.ceil, shield absorbs first. Three amounts: requested = table; applied = after AP / crit / defense / floor of 1; takenDamage (returned, unused here) = shield + hp actually lost.

declaredRaw.label: flat speed points removed (requested), NOT a percentage despite the source comment

effects.scaling: requested = -10 (Wooper) / -20 (Quagsire). Applied value = -N x (1 + caster AP / 100) x (crit ? critPower : 1), with no rounding; Big Eater Belt does not apply (the caster is an enemy and the value is negative); a Twist Band on the target flips the sign (the target gains speed); a MELMETAL target instead receives addAttack(value x 0.5) with the same caster scaling, rounded, and Twist Band applied again there.
effects.resolution: target.speed = clamp(speed + value, 0, 300). Attack interval = 1000 / (0.4 + speed x 0.007) ms (halved speed while paralysed), so a lower speed lengthens it. The change is permanent for the fight (no duration or expiry in this strategy; permanent = false, so the board unit is not changed) and is applied even when the damage was blocked.

starBehavior.note: Both tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars (fallback 200 / 40). Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None in the strategy beyond the current target; no geometry.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. Each cast spends maxPP of PP. Speed reductions stack additively down to 0 across casts (clamp); there is no cap on how often it can be applied and no duration.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: 25 / 50 special damage and -10 / -20 speed. Applied: damage after AP, enrage, crit, speDef and the floor of 1 (zero if the target is protected); speed change after AP, crit, Twist Band / MELMETAL handling and the 0..300 clamp.
